title: 7.3. Vipākattika
note: Pāli only: every English translation of the Abhidhamma is still under copyright, so no English can be shown yet. A free translation will be added if one becomes available.

verses.t: Navipākaṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca navipāko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā …pe….
Hetuyā bāttiṁsa, ārammaṇe sattavīsa, adhipatiyā ekūnatiṁsa …pe… aññamaññe tiṁsa …pe… purejāte catuvīsa, āsevane sattarasa …pe… vipāke pañcavīsa …pe… avigate bāttiṁsa.
